title: migrate --apply fails on a real project because its receipt is written under the ordinary 64 KiB record bound
symptom: Applying the migration of this repository fails with 'managed file exceeds 65536 bytes' for the receipt, after the 0.6.0 files were already written, leaving both layouts in the tree
trigger: Preview and apply chough migrate on a project with a few hundred 0.5.x files, such as this repository in a throwaway clone
expected: The receipt applies within its own 4,194,304-byte bound (REQ-records-001), and a receipt over that bound refuses before anything is written
actual: The receipt is written with the 65,536-byte ordinary record bound and refuses only after the planned files were written
steps: Commit a 0.5.x project with about 400 removable files
Run chough migrate, then chough migrate --apply <digest> --consent <source>
impact: No real project can migrate; a refused apply leaves the 0.6.0 files beside every 0.5.x file until it is resumed
source: t37j's second migration rehearsal (plan Migration step 3) at d57d3aea in a throwaway clone

notes.text: Red on the current apply: TC-records-migrate-receipt-bound fails with 'managed file exceeds 65536 bytes' for the receipt; revision b405da6e on leif/0.6.0-receipt-bound-red.
status: open -> verified. Green on the fix: TC-records-migrate-receipt-bound passes; a 400-file project's receipt applies within the receipt bound.
